en.description:
Your Little Pet on Your Wrist!

Watch Puppy is a pixel-style virtual pet app designed exclusively for Apple Watch.
Your pet gets hungry, reacts to your touch, and enjoys spending time with you — all in short, delightful moments on your wrist.

No pressure, no complexity.
Just a small companion you can check in on anytime.

Features

1. Pixel Art Pet
A charming retro-style pixel pet with expressive reactions.

2. Hunger & Interaction System
Feed, interact, and see how your pet responds.

3. Apple Watch–Only Experience
Optimized for quick launches, light performance, and short interactions.

4. Growth Over Time
Your pet changes subtly as you spend time together.

5. Offline & Private
Works without internet connection. No data collection.

6. Perfect for You If…
You enjoy virtual pets and casual simulation games
You love pixel art and retro aesthetics

You want a small moment of calm during a busy day

You often check your Apple Watch and enjoy playful interactions

Privacy
This app works completely offline.
It does not collect, store, or share any personal data.

Take care of your little pet,
right on your wrist !
en.releaseNotes: - Fixed a translation error in the app subtitle
en.subtitle: A little pet on your wrist!
